sloka: रामप्रव्राजनं चैव देवि याचस्व तं वरम् ।एवं सिद्ध्यन्ति पुत्रस्य सर्वार्थास्तव भामिनि ॥२-९-३२॥
transliteration: rāmapravrājanaṁ caiva devi yācasva taṁ varam ।evaṁ siddhyanti putrasya sarvārthāstava bhāmini ॥2-9-32॥

translations.english: O Devi demand Rama's exile as a boon. O lovely queen this way all the interests of your son will be fulfilled (protected).
